full_prompt_en: The image is a square atmospheric digital painting of a dark sea beneath turbulent clouds, with crimson light breaking through blue-black shadow. The background is almost entirely sky, extending from the upper edge to a low, narrow horizon near the bottom of the frame. At the top left, broad masses of charcoal cloud overlap one another, their contours soft and uneven rather than cleanly outlined. Across the upper centre, a cooler slate-blue opening lies behind the darker cloud bank and gives the storm a sense of deep recession. Towards the upper right, a heavy rolling formation curves inward, directing attention to the lighter space below it. In the centre, muted rose and smoky coral light spreads through a ragged gap between cloud layers, strongest just below the midpoint. The luminous opening has an irregular branching shape, with wisps and smaller dark forms interrupting it rather than leaving a simple empty hole. On the left of this opening, nearly black vapour rises diagonally and creates a forceful silhouette against the warmer glow. Along the right side, patches of dusty mauve and burnt red trace the undersides of the cloud masses, gradually disappearing into indigo shadow. The visible texture is made from soft, interwoven strokes and hazy transitions, with a few sharper edges wherever one cloud overlaps another. Lower in the frame, a dense band of dark cloud stretches horizontally above the water and compresses the distance. The horizon itself remains thin and subdued, without a distinct building, vessel or human presence. Across the lower edge, the sea is a nearly black plane streaked by small, flattened ripples. A faint red reflection lies below the brightest region of sky, broken into short horizontal marks rather than forming a broad shining path. The water stays substantially darker and smoother than the cloud field, providing a quiet base for the restless sky. Small cool glints at the left and centre hint at the uneven surface without describing large crashing waves. The lighting appears to come from a concealed warm source beyond the clouds, illuminating their thinner interiors and leaving the thick outer banks in shadow. No separate visible sun disk interrupts the storm. The overall composition is dominated by sweeping, layered cloud forms and a low dark sea, balancing a restrained crimson core with expansive blue-black shadows to produce a brooding, luminous atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形氛围数字绘画，黑暗海面上方翻涌着风暴云，绯红光芒从蓝黑阴影之间透出。背景几乎全部是天空，从上沿一直延伸至靠近底部的低窄地平线。左上方大片炭灰云团相互叠压，轮廓柔软参差，并非整齐描边。上方中央一处较冷的石板蓝开口位于深色云层后面，使风暴具有纵深。右上方厚重卷云向内弯曲，将视线引向下方较亮的区域。中央灰玫瑰色与烟雾般的珊瑚红光穿过破碎云隙，在画面中点稍下方最为明显。明亮开口形状不规则且有分支，细云丝和小块暗云横穿其中，并不是一个空洞。开口左边，接近黑色的云气斜向上升，在暖光前形成有力剪影。右侧尘紫与暗红色斑沿云团下缘延伸，逐渐消失在靛蓝阴影中。可见质感由柔和交错的笔触与朦胧过渡构成，只有云层相互遮挡的位置出现稍清楚的边缘。再向下，一带厚实暗云水平压在水面上方，使远景显得低沉。地平线细而不突出，看不到明确的建筑、船只或人物。沿画面下沿，海水接近黑色，只分布一些扁平细碎波纹。最明亮天空下方有淡红倒影，呈断续短横笔触，没有形成宽阔闪光通道。水面比云层更暗、更平滑，为动荡天空提供安静基底。左边与中央少量冷色亮点暗示水面的起伏，没有大浪冲击。光似乎来自云后被遮住的暖色光源，照亮较薄云层内部，厚重外围云团仍在阴影中。风暴天空里没有另外出现清晰日轮。整体以横扫画面的层叠云形和低矮暗海为主，让克制的绯红光心与广阔蓝黑阴影相互平衡，营造阴沉而内含光亮的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The rendering is painterly and atmospheric, with broad dark masses surrounding a small, irregular area of warm illumination. Charcoal, indigo and muted blue-green occupy most of the value range, while dusty crimson and smoky coral appear inside softened boundaries. Layered, curling contours establish movement without hard outlines. Fine tonal shifts reveal depth within the shadows, and a few sharper overlapping edges prevent the darkness from becoming flat. Light is concealed and diffused, glowing through thinner passages rather than striking every surface equally. The overall balance is expansive and foreboding, with low-key values, restrained saturation and concentrated internal luminosity.
style_prompt_zh: 表现方式具有绘画感和空气感，大片深色形体围绕一小块不规则暖光展开。炭灰、靛蓝和暗蓝绿色占据主要明度范围，尘红与烟雾般的珊瑚色出现在柔化边缘内部。层叠卷曲轮廓带来运动感，不依靠坚硬描边。暗部细微色阶变化表现深度，少量较清楚的遮挡边缘避免黑暗变成平面。光源隐蔽而漫射，从较薄区域内部透亮，不均匀照亮所有表面。整体以低调明度、克制饱和度和集中的内部亮光形成辽阔而压迫的气氛。
theme_en: Dark ocean beneath a crimson storm sky
theme_zh: 暗海上空透出绯红光芒的风暴云
name: Dark foreboding colors
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
